## Source
The train was late again. Peter checked his watch for the third time and sighed. The platform smelled of rain and cheap coffee. Somewhere behind him a child was crying, and a loudspeaker was mumbling something completely unintelligible. He thought about the letter in his pocket — two pages that had taken him a whole week to write. Maybe, in the end, he would not send it after all.
